Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with a piano roll, MIDI Workbench, same-PC ensemble song sharing, a low-render follower camera, Showmaster, and MP4 concert capture. Includes customizable shortcut bars with commands, macros, radial menus, condition sets and shareable layouts.
Changelog: Added Shortcut Bars with dockable layouts, nested categories, spacer labels, game and custom icons, clickable command and macro buttons, radial hotkeys, condition sets and clipboard sharing.
